forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'runCode: a failed snippet shows the errors its tool calls returned'
+---
+planner24 SWE-bench run of FoundationModelsACPAgent: in 4 of the 6 kanban errors, `tools.kanban.runKanban` returned `{"errors":[...]}` with no `data`, and the snippet then read `r.data.addTask`. The model saw only "The snippet failed: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'r.data.addTask') (line 11)". It never saw the real cause. Examples: 14411 seq 21873 (Variable "$col" of type "String!" used in position expecting type "ID"), 14155 seq 16123, and 14580 seq 24039 (GRAPHQL_PARSE_FAILED).
+
+Fix: record, per runCode invocation, each tools.* return value (an object, or JSON text of one) that carries a non-empty `errors` list, an `error`, `isError: true`, or a `correction`. When the snippet fails, put "A tool call in this snippet returned errors: tools.<path>: [CODE] message; …" between the JS error and the closing directive, with each message capped. A snippet that succeeds is unchanged.
+
+Tests: a snippet that reads `.data` of a GraphQL error result fails with the tool name, the code and the message in the text; a failing snippet whose calls returned no errors is unchanged; a snippet that succeeds after a call returned errors is unchanged. #runCode
\ No newline at end of file
